text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-04, a blank render bug in ui/components/DataTable.tsx was fixed.","The blank render bug only occurred when two requests raced on the same key.","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The bug manifested as an empty tbody element with no console error.","The fix was implemented in PR #5468 on branch fix/blank-render-1.","A property test was added to prevent regression of the off-by-one slice bound bug.","The fix reduced job completion time from 5 hours to 67 minutes.","The bug occurred in the same area of ui/components/DataTable.tsx as earlier blank render work."]}
